name: follow-tracker
description: Extensión Manifest V3 para guardar capturas locales de Instagram, comparar relaciones entre fechas y auditar el historial sin backend.

scripts.test: node --test extension/core.test.js extension/history.test.js extension/export-policy.test.js extension/product-core.test.js extension/background.test.js
scripts.check: node --check extension/core.js && node --check extension/history.js && node --check extension/export-policy.js && node --check extension/product-core.js && node --check extension/content.js && node --check extension/background.js && node --check extension/popup.js && node --check extension/dashboard.js && node --check extension/dashboard-table.js && node --check extension/dashboard-ux.js && node --check extension/dashboard-product.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('node:fs').readFileSync('extension/manifest.json','utf8'))" && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('extension/manifest.json','utf8')); for (const p of Object.values(m.icons || {})) if (!fs.existsSync('extension/'+p)) throw new Error('Falta icono: '+p)"
